decision.reason: Exact index-valued curl. Use merge-split cancellation and the structural isomorphisms, then evaluate the reverse cup followed by the multiplication cap as the subgroup-index scalar.
decision.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a S finite down loopUp loopDown straight cup middle cap curl
  have hmid :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeDown Complex a d).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.splitDown Complex a d) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d).tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a)) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown_splitDown a d
  have hcup :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCap Complex d) =
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H)).scale
        (S.index : Complex) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup_multiplicationCap d finite
  simp only [curl, middle, cup, cap, straight, down, loopDown, loopUp,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval, hmid, MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_id, ← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate_unassociate, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((MackeyDiagrams.Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a))),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical, hcup,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_left, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.insertLeftUnit_leftUnit]
